title: Add independent invoice and multiasset reserve reference tests
body:
Add two public Core/1 integration tests backed by independent invoice and multiasset reserve fixtures. The linked invoice collections47/80 include6 total fees and preserve a warranty duty. The reserve transfers50 CASH plus fee2, retains5 CASH, partially discharges BOND and preserves the emergency duty. Tests compare complete financial snapshots and ordered effects across all39 statement prefixes, successor linkage, and literal aggregate work42/42/45.

Validation: on exact head `59d44023b7f2e33e45350030101c95bcda19eb90` / tree `33a39221d279f6feba518bc2184b526056ce3071`, one offline SDK-free Core command passed both new financial tests and all5 existing continuation tests in28.8seconds. Source and actual results received fresh independent reviews. The authorized Gemini security fallback was used after an observed Opus rate rejection; all receipts and corrections are retained. The source tree stayed clean and temporary artifacts were removed.

The seven payloads copy the independently frozen v2 oracle byte for byte. V1 is preserved after a static review found the reserve balance-array ordering defect; v2 changes only wire order/derivation, with amounts, effects and work unchanged. No expected data was regenerated from execution, and comparisons remain exact. #193 supplies the default Core dependency feature.

This establishes only the tested local Core/1 financial projection and existing Core/2 continuation cases. Step.value/ExprId wire identity, per-prefix measured work, full CLI/workspace/SDK compatibility, Rust formatting/Clippy, generic compiler/intent/ZKIR/native proof and ledger qualification remain open. No full U2 or original requirement closure is claimed. Related: #84, #85, #86.
